title: Pineapple Coconut Muffins
summary: These healthy pineapple coconut muffins are soft, naturally sweet, and made with no added sugar. Perfect for babies, toddlers, and a delicious make-ahead snack the whole family will love.
ingredients: 6 ounces (3/4 cup) whole fat plain Greek yogurt
1/2 cup unsweetened shredded coconut + more for topping
steps: In the blender or food processor, add the oats first and then the rest of the ingredients minus the pineapple and coconut. Blend until smooth. Stir in the last two ingredients. Be sure to drain out as much liquid from the pineapple if using canned or frozen
Pour batter evenly into a greased or lined 12-cup muffin pan. Top with remaining more coconut, if you wish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, until inserted toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely (wait at least 10 minutes) before taking them out of the pan.
